list.title: Incidents
list.intro: An incident ties alerts, findings and actions into one story. A significant incident under NIS2 has reporting deadlines to the CSIRT: an early warning within 24 h of becoming aware, a notification within 72 h and a final report within a month.
list.empty: No incidents in this view. Create one here or from the alert list (select alerts → “To incident”).

activity.reportSubmitted: marked as submitted to the CSIRT: {{kind}}
activity.evidence: Evidence package requested from the NIS2 archive (export #{{id}}, {{from}} – {{to}}, agents: {{agents}}).

report_editor.submitted: Submitted to the CSIRT {{date}} ({{by}}){{reference}}. The text below is the submitted version and cannot be changed.
report_editor.hint: Vardr prepares a draft from the incident data; fill in the “[uzupełnij]” (to complete) fields, send it through your CSIRT's channel (portal, e-mail) and mark it as submitted here – the deadlines will stop counting.
report_editor.placeholder: No content – click “Draft from incident data”.
report_editor.replaceConfirm: Replace the current text with a new draft?
report_editor.submitInfo: The text from the editor will be stored as submitted and frozen. The change is recorded in the audit log.
report_editor.draftLanguage: The draft is generated in the chosen language (by default the system language) – the national CSIRT usually expects the report in Polish.

detail.closedInfo: Incident closed {{date}} – read only. Closing cannot be undone; if the threat returns, open a new incident.
detail.iocs: Indicators of compromise (IoC) – addresses, file hashes, domains
detail.significant: Significant incident (must be reported to the CSIRT)
detail.deadlinesHint: Once marked as significant, the panel tracks the reporting deadlines and sends reminders to notification channels (the “incidents” event).
detail.evidence: Evidence package from the NIS2 archive
detail.evidenceTooLong: the alerts span more than 31 days – request the export manually in the Archive
detail.evidenceDone: Export #{{id}} requested – it will be ready in NIS2 archive → Export for auditor
detail.noAlerts: No alerts. Add them from the alert list (select → “To incident”) or from the alert details.
detail.closeWarning: Closing is final: the incident becomes read only (no changes, notes, alerts or reports).
detail.closeWarningNis2: A significant incident can be closed after the final report is marked as submitted.
detail.summaryHint: course of events, impact, lessons learned – added to the timeline
detail.notePlaceholder: Note: findings, decisions, contact with the CSIRT…
